news.title: Spalletti Defends David’s Brief Cameo in Juventus Pre-Season Win
news.text: Luciano Spalletti says Jonathan David's early substitution against Chelsea was always the plan, as Juventus managed minutes carefully in their 1-0 Hong Kong win. The post Spalletti Defends David’s Brief Cameo in Juventus Pre-Season Win appeared first on Juvefc.com.

news.title: Yildiz Fit for Verona as Vlahovic Eyes Starting Role — Spalletti
